# AVM submodule — Private Endpoint (`Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints`)

Creates a single private endpoint to a Private Link service, with optional managed DNS zone group, per-endpoint management lock, and per-endpoint role assignments. The lock and role assignments are delegated to the sibling `../lock` and `../role_assignment` submodules per TFRMNFR1.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD033 -->

- <a name="requirement_terraform"></a> [terraform](#requirement\_terraform) (>= 1.9, < 2.0)

- <a name="requirement_azapi"></a> [azapi](#requirement\_azapi) (~> 2.8)

- <a name="requirement_random"></a> [random](#requirement\_random) (~> 3.5)

Description: (Required) The fully-qualified resource ID of the target Azure resource being privately connected to (e.g. the Search Service ID).

Type: `string`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_dns_zone_group_resource_ids"></a> [dns\_zone\_group\_resource\_ids](#output\_dns\_zone\_group\_resource\_ids)

Description: Map of private DNS zone group resource IDs, keyed by the private endpoint key. Only PEs with DNS zones supplied are present.

### <a name="output_lock_resource_ids"></a> [lock\_resource\_ids](#output\_lock\_resource\_ids)

Description: Map of per-private-endpoint lock resource IDs, keyed by the private endpoint key. Only PEs with locks supplied are present.

### <a name="output_resource"></a> [resource](#output\_resource)

Description: Map of private endpoint AzAPI resources, keyed by the input map key.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Map of private endpoint resource IDs, keyed by the input map key. (RMFR7 — the primary resource of this submodule is a collection.)

### <a name="output_role_assignment_resource_ids"></a> [role\_assignment\_resource\_ids](#output\_role\_assignment\_resource\_ids)

Description: Map of per-private-endpoint role assignment resource IDs, keyed by `<pe_key>-<ra_key>`.
